ABOUT ME

I'm a graphic designer from Chennai with a strong foundation in printing technology and a passion for visual storytelling. I believe great design solves problems while making people feel something.

With hands-on experience at Pixxelo Solutions, I've worked on image retouching, path selection, background removal, poster design, and digital graphics. My background in printing technology gives me a unique edge — I understand how designs translate from screen to print.

I'm constantly learning, experimenting with new styles, and pushing my creative limits through personal concept projects.
